# Loner-Strike: Human-like bots, map & mode tools, and servers for CS 1.6 + CZ

> Loner-Strike is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0) desktop app for Counter-Strike 1.6 and Counter-Strike: Condition Zero on Steam. It makes bots play like people, installs classic community mods patched so bots can play them, adds its own modes (Last Stand and Battle Royale), and gives you one control panel for your own game or a dedicated server, including from your phone. Version 1.0 adds Tools for making things (a map editor that compiles and playtests with bots, Game Mode Studio, Plugin Studio and more), a Community browser for sharing maps and modes, and an MCP connector for AI coding agents. Windows, and Mac through CrossOver. Made by nanoshrine.

Key facts:

- Price: free. Optional "name your price" payment on the website; the download is the same either way.
- Games: Counter-Strike 1.6 and Condition Zero, Steam versions only. Non-Steam copies are not supported.
- Platforms: Windows. Mac through CrossOver (the Mac version of Counter-Strike can't run mods). With Parallels, use the Windows version inside the virtual machine.
- Safe to remove: every file it changes is backed up; removing a mode, or all of Loner-Strike, puts the game back as it was.
- Friends don't need the app: anyone with the game joins like any other server.
- Not affiliated with Valve.

## Docs

- [Website](https://lonerstrike.com/): what it does, screenshots, download and FAQ
- [Full details for AI assistants](https://lonerstrike.com/llms-full.txt): features, setup, servers and FAQ in plain text
- [Docs](https://lonerstrike.com/docs): setup, the app, the bots, game modes, every tool, servers, Community, AI agents, in-game commands and troubleshooting
- [What's new in 1.0](https://lonerstrike.com/docs#whats-new): the new modes, Tools, Community and AI agents
- [Map editor](https://lonerstrike.com/docs#map-editor) and [Game Mode Studio](https://lonerstrike.com/docs#game-mode-studio): making maps and modes
- [Connect an AI agent](https://lonerstrike.com/docs#mcp): MCP setup for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor and others
- [Community](https://lonerstrike.com/docs#community): sharing and trying creations
- [Run a server on a VPS](https://lonerstrike.com/docs#vps): step-by-step guide to an always-on server on a rented Linux machine
- [README on GitHub](https://github.com/jamesontucker/Loner-Strike#readme): features, install and how it works
- [Linux server guide (Markdown)](https://github.com/jamesontucker/Loner-Strike/blob/main/docs/linux-server.md): the full VPS guide, with troubleshooting

## Download

- [Latest release](https://github.com/jamesontucker/Loner-Strike/releases/latest): Windows and Mac builds (the Mac one signed and notarized), with updates in the app
- [Changelog](https://github.com/jamesontucker/Loner-Strike/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): what changed in each version
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/K9eBHVVwZE): community, help and bug reports
- Our server: `connect play.lonerstrike.com` in Counter-Strike 1.6 (bots and the community modes, 24/7)
- [Source code](https://github.com/jamesontucker/Loner-Strike): Rust (Tauri) app, React control panel, AMX Mod X plugins
